test_cases.title: TC-TIB-004 — [Validation] Each URL resolves to its own artwork's print file
test_cases.expectedResult: design_urls[i] content matches artwork i's own design; no artwork's file is duplicated or swapped with another's.
test_cases.actualResult: Downloaded design_urls[0] (same customization as TC-003) — HTTP 200, content-type image/png , 843KB, real rendered design content (not empty/corrupt/placeholder-broken). Note: this environment only has 1 artwork, so the "not duplicated/swapped with another artwork" part of this case could not be verified — that requires a 2-artwork customization, which could not be provisioned this session. Marked passed for the single-artwork-testable part only (resolves correctly to real content).

test_cases.title: TC-TIB-005 — [Validation] File extension matches each artwork's design_format
test_cases.expectedResult: Extension in each URL matches that specific artwork's own design_format .
test_cases.actualResult: Artwork 2179 has design_format: "rgb" (from platform-product API). Resulting URL extension is .png . Confirmed from SDK source ( retrieveDesignExt → function Zc ): explicit cases exist for svg/eps/ai/jpeg/jpeg_cmyk/jpeg_cmyk_coated_fogra39/pdf; anything else (including "rgb") falls to default: return "png" — by design, not a bug. Extension correctly derives from this artwork's own design_format .

test_cases.title: TC-TIB-010 — [Security] Design URL cannot be used to enumerate another customization's artwork design
test_cases.expectedResult: Behavior/access-control model for design URLs not specified in the ticket — confirm with Dev whether URLs are intentionally public-by-design or should be access-restricted before treating any result as pass/fail. Note: PO/DEV confirm — pre-existing URL pattern, not introduced by this ticket; confirm scope before logging as a bug.
test_cases.actualResult: Observed (not a conclusion — access-control policy for design URLs still needs PO/DEV confirmation per the task's open question): Valid design_urls URL: fully public, no auth header/token required, served from object storage (S3/Ceph-RGW style, cache-control 7 days). Guessing a different artwork id within the same valid customization UUID → 403 (object storage access-denied style response), no content/data leaked. Security therefore relies entirely on the customization UUID being unguessable (standard UUIDv4 entropy) — there is no additional token/auth layer. Left as blocked , not passed/failed: whether "public-by-design, secured only by unguessable UUID" is the intended/accepted model is a product decision for PO/Dev, not something to self-declare pass/fail on. Pre-existing URL pattern, not introduced by this ticket.
